32:     if (count === 1) return shades.veryLight;
33:     if (count <= 3) return shades.light;

42:   // Build a 7-row × 13-week grid ending today (col 0 = oldest).
43:   const grid = useMemo(() => {
44:     const today = new Date();
45:     today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
46:     // Find the most recent Saturday (end-of-week on day 6 of grid if we treat Sun=0..Sat=6)
47:     const todayDay = today.getDay();
48:     const end = new Date(today);
49:     end.setDate(today.getDate() + (6 - todayDay));
50: 
51:     const cells: Array<{ date: string; count: number; col: number; row: number } | null> = [];
52:     const start = new Date(end);
53:     start.setDate(start.getDate() - (WEEKS * DAYS - 1));
54:

56:     for (let col = 0; col < WEEKS; col++) {
57:       for (let row = 0; row < DAYS; row++) {
58:         const d = new Date(start);
59:         d.setDate(start.getDate() + idx);
60:         const isFuture = d.getTime() > today.getTime();
61:         const key = dateKey(d);
62:         cells.push(
63:           isFuture
64:             ? null
65:             : { date: key, count: activity[key] ?? 0, col, row }
66:         );
67:         idx++;
68:       }
69:     }
